To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have characterized 27 human B cell precursor (Bcp) leukemia cell lines.
we have established 27 BCP cell lines of which 25 are B-I pro-B cells, 1 is a B-II common-B cells and 1 a B-III pre B cell.

BCP-cell lines can be established with success rates of 10-15% and that they can be classified into three categories according to the expression of CD10, cytoplasmic immunoglobulin (cIg) and the presence of the TdT enzyme.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and use of human BCP-cell lines for basic and translational research.
the characterization and molecular genetic analyses of a panel of human B cell leukemia cell lines.
the establishment, characterization and application of BCP-cell lines.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of well characterized BCP-cell lines provides unprecedented opportunities for studying the biology and immunology of normal and neoplasia B-lymphoid cells.
the establishment and characterization of a large number of human BCP-cell lines has provided unprecedented opportunities for studying the biology of normal and malignant B lymphocytes.
BCP-cell lines have provided a unique opportunity for studying the biology of B-lymphopoiesis and BCP-ALL.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the BCP-cell lines have proven to be a valuable tool to understand the pathophysiological mechanisms of leukemogenesis.
the BCP-cell lines represent a valuable and unique research tool for the study of normal and neoplasia of human B cells.
the establishment and characterization of BCP-cell lines is a worthwhile endeavor and should be pursued.
The main takeaway from our work is that
BCP-cell lines can be a valuable tool for the study of normal B cell development and B cell leukemia.

the use of well-established BCP-cell lines will provide unprecedented opportunities for the study of a multitude of biological and molecular aspects related to normal or malignant B-lymphocyte development.
the use of well-defined cell lines is a prerequisite for meaningful research.
